definitions.explanation: Performed with no instrumental accompaniment — a voice or solo instrument on its own. Formed from {無|む} (without) plus {伴奏|ばんそう} (accompaniment). Used attributively with の or before a noun.

examples.japanese: {無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧。
バッハ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦チェロ→チェロ：08115_chero⟧{組曲|くみきょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
examples.english: I love Bach's unaccompanied cello suites.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合唱|がっしょう}→合唱：04900_gasshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{書|か}かれている→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: This piece was written for unaccompanied chorus.

notes:
A term of classical music. Used before a noun or with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ to describe a work or performance with no accompaniment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦チェロ→チェロ：08115_chero⟧{組曲|くみきょく}: unaccompanied cello suite
- {無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦{合唱|がっしょう}→合唱：04900_gasshou⟧: unaccompanied chorus (a cappella)
- {無伴奏|むばんそう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧: to sing without accompaniment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦アカペラ→アカペラ：30017_akapera⟧: a cappella — the everyday word for unaccompanied singing, especially in pop and choral contexts
- ⟦{独奏|どくそう}→独奏：07539_dokusou⟧: solo (instrumental) — one player, but does not itself mean "without accompaniment"
